text_licence.description: open: requirement text may be quoted (EU law, US government works). ids-only: numbers, titles where permitted, and own-words paraphrase only (ISO, PCI DSS, CIS, AICPA).

summary.description: Quoted (open licence, short) or paraphrased requirement.

relationship.description: Set-theory relationship of the capability set to the requirement, after NIST OLIR. 'supports' = contributes evidence without satisfying it.

basis.description: official: from a crosswalk published by the framework owner or NIST (cite it in source_ref). derived: this repo's own judgement.

rationale.description: Why these capabilities answer this requirement, framed in the framework's own terms.
